    "The epoxy was the one item I would try because it could help with small hardware repairs alongside my recent fastening supplies.",

  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying fastening supplies seems to have been taken as interest in almost any repair or workshop product.",
    "Shared words such as nails or fasteners seem to have mattered more than differences in purpose, dimensions, and tool compatibility."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated framing-nail and wood-screw purchases point toward particular fastening needs, where angle, gauge, length, and intended use affect whether an item is useful.",
    "My medicine cups and vacuum bags were separate needs; buying supplies for several tasks does not mean I currently need equipment for other unrelated jobs."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in fastening and small repairs, but stretched it into too many unrelated tasks without enough attention to purpose and compatibility."
}
